description: Use this when you want a derived build-next signal from agent demand: supply-demand gaps and the 30-day payment conversion funnel. Aggregates only (k-anonymized). Deprecated alias of get_insights_data(kind="signals"). Read-only. Example: get_market_insights(). Price: 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Payment: call without a credential to get payment_required (isError=true) with a Lightning invoice, macaroon and, if enabled, x402 terms (USDC on Base). Pay it yourself (this server never pays), then repeat the identical call with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (HTTP equivalent: Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>; single use, valid 10 min), x402_payment / params._meta['x402/payment'], or credit_token (prepaid, see buy_credits). Invalid input is rejected before any invoice. Copy-pasteable examples: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
